newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Itau Bankers Trust to launch investment funds.
newsitem.headline: Itau Bankers Trust to launch investment funds.

text.p: Itau Bankers Trust next week will launch investment funds earmarked for domestic institutional investors and corporate clients, a bank director said.

Itau Bankers Trust is a partnership between Brazilian private bank Banco Itau and U.S. investment bank Bankers Trust, focusing on capital markets, mergers and acquisitions, risk management, derivatives and now asset management.

"We want to be one of the top players in this (asset management) market," said Roberto Nishikawa, Itau Bankers Trust Asset Management executive director, who heads IBT's recently built asset management area.

The funds designed for local institutional and corporate clients are only the first of Itau Bankers Trust's products to be offered to investors. IBT also plans to launch funds and offer its asset management services to foreign investors and top individual clients.
Nishikawa could not estimate how much IBT plans to raise, but he said the bank will be very "aggressive" in drawing investors.
Itau Bankers Trust was born following Banco Itau's initiative to have an independent investment bank with a global partner.
IBT began operations earlier this year, with a capital of $50 million, Nishikawa said.
Itau is Brazil's second largest private bank, after Bradesco, focusing mainly on retail banking.

With offices in 50 countries, Bankers Trust is very active in mergers and acquisitions, having joined forces with Wolfensohn & Co., which brokered about $45 billion in M&As last year. It currently manages $215 billion in assets, he added.
